offering_description.value: Summit Hotel Properties is a real estate investment trust that provides short-stay and extended-stay lodging to business and leisure travelers. It owns primarily upscale, select-service hotels and hires third-party managers to run them under major hotel brands.

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; extended-stay lodging; meeting and event hosting; hotel food and beverage service

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers and individuals booking business or extended stays; B2B: corporate travel buyers, meeting planners and organizations booking room blocks

end_markets.value: business travel; leisure travel; extended-stay lodging; meetings and events

revenue_model.value: service fees: nightly room charges, meeting space bookings and food and beverage purchases

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: acquires and owns hotel properties and contracts with third-party managers to serve travelers and groups

geography_served.value: US national: hotel markets across the South, Northeast, Midwest and West

specialization.value: niche specialist: hotel ownership focused on upscale select-service properties, including extended-stay hotels

distribution_channels.value: online: hotel brand websites and apps, plus online travel agencies; direct sales: hotel sales teams handling corporate accounts, room blocks and meetings; own locations: hotel front desks handling walk-in reservations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hotel accessibility, fire safety and food-service rules, plus federal REIT tax requirements
